source.text: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ףאֱֽלֹהִ֗ים נִצָּ֥ב בַּעֲדַת־אֵ֑ל בְּקֶ֖רֶב אֱלֹהִ֣ים יִשְׁפֹּֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: A psalm of Asaph. God stands in [the] assembly of God; in [the] midst of [the] gods he judges.

en.L: A psalm of Asaph. \q God stands in the assembly of God; \q in the midst of the gods {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} judges.
en.B: A psalm of Asaph. \q God takes {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} stand in the divine assembly; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gives judgment among the gods.
en.R: A song of Asaph. \q God stands up in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} great council in heaven. \q He judges those there who are called gods.

fr.L: Psaume d’Asaph. \q Dieu se tient dans l’assemblée de Dieu ; \q au milieu des dieux {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} juge.
fr.B: Psaume d’Asaph. \q Dieu prend place dans l’assemblée divine ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} rend son jugement parmi les dieux.
fr.R: Chant d’Asaph. \q Dieu se lève dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} grand conseil, au ciel. \q Il juge ceux qui, là-haut, sont appelés des dieux.

sw.L: Zaburi ya Asafu. \q Mungu anasimama katika kusanyiko la Mungu; \q katikati ya miungu anahukumu.
sw.B: Zaburi ya Asafu. \q Mungu anasimama mahali {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}} katika baraza la mbinguni; \q anatoa hukumu kati ya miungu.
sw.R: Wimbo wa Asafu. \q Mungu anasimama katika baraza {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} kuu mbinguni. \q Anawahukumu wale walioko huko wanaoitwa miungu.

es.L: Salmo de Asaf. \q Dios está de pie en la asamblea de Dios; \q en medio de los dioses {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} juzga.
es.B: Salmo de Asaf. \q Dios ocupa {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} lugar en la asamblea divina; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dicta sentencia en medio de los dioses.
es.R: Canto de Asaf. \q Dios se pone de pie en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gran consejo en el cielo. \q Él juzga a los que allí son llamados dioses.

vi.L: [Một] thi thiên của A-sáp. \q Đức Chúa Trời đứng trong hội đồng của Đức Chúa Trời; \q giữa các thần {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xét xử.
vi.B: Thi thiên của A-sáp. \q Đức Chúa Trời đứng lên giữa hội đồng thiên thượng; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xét xử giữa các thần.
vi.R: Bài ca của A-sáp. \q Đức Chúa Trời đứng lên trong hội đồng lớn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên trời. \q Ngài xét xử những kẻ ở đó được gọi là thần.

ko.L: 아삽의 시. \q 하나님께서 하나님의 회의 가운데 서시고, \q 신들 가운데서 재판하신다.
ko.B: 아삽의 시. \q 하나님께서 하늘의 회의에 자리를 잡고 서시며, \q 신들 가운데서 심판하신다.
ko.R: 아삽이 지은 노래. \q 하나님께서 하늘에 있는 그분의 큰 회의에서 일어서신다. \q 거기에서 신이라고 불리는 이들을 심판하신다.

pt.L: Salmo de Asafe. \q Deus está de pé na assembleia de Deus; \q no meio dos deuses {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} julga.
pt.B: Salmo de Asafe. \q Deus toma o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} lugar na assembleia divina; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} dá a sentença no meio dos deuses.
pt.R: Canção de Asafe. \q Deus se levanta no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} grande conselho no céu. \q Ele julga os que ali são chamados deuses.

am.L: የአሳፍ መዝሙር። \q እግዚአብሔር በእግዚአብሔር ጉባኤ ውስጥ ቆሟል፤ \q በአማልክት መካከል ይፈርዳል።
am.B: የአሳፍ መዝሙር። \q እግዚአብሔር በመለኮታዊው ጉባኤ ውስጥ ስፍራውን ይዞ ቆሟል፤ \q በአማልክት መካከል ፍርድ ይሰጣል።
am.R: አሳፍ የዘመረው መዝሙር። \q እግዚአብሔር በሰማይ ባለው በታላቁ ሸንጎው ውስጥ ተነሥቶ ቆሟል። \q በዚያ አማልክት ተብለው በሚጠሩት ላይ ይፈርዳል።

hi.L: आसाप का भजन। \q परमेश्वर परमेश्वर की सभा में खड़े हैं; \q देवताओं के बीच वे न्याय करते हैं।
hi.B: आसाप का भजन। \q परमेश्वर ईश्वरीय सभा में अपना स्थान लेते हैं; \q वे देवताओं के बीच न्याय करते हैं।
hi.R: आसाप का गीत। \q परमेश्वर स्वर्ग में अपनी बड़ी सभा में खड़े होते हैं। \q वे उनका न्याय करते हैं जो वहाँ देवता कहलाते हैं।

ru.L: Псалом Асафа. \q Бог стоит в собрании Божьем; \q среди богов {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} судит.
ru.B: Псалом Асафа. \q Бог занимает своё место в небесном собрании; \q {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} выносит суд среди богов.
ru.R: Песнь Асафа. \q Бог встаёт в своём великом небесном совете. \q Он судит тех, кто там называется богами.

ja.L: アサフの賛歌。 \q 神は、神の集いの中に立ち、 \q 神々の真ん中でお裁きになる。
ja.B: アサフの賛歌。 \q 神は、天の会議の中にお立ちになり、 \q 神々の間で裁きを行われる。
ja.R: アサフの歌。 \q 神は、天にあるご自分の大いなる会議の中で、立ち上がられる。 \q 神々と呼ばれる者たちを、お裁きになる。

uk.L: Псалом Асафа. \q Бог стоїть у зібранні Бога; \q посеред богів {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} судить.
uk.B: Псалом Асафа. \q Бог стає в божественному зібранні; \q {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} чинить суд серед богів.
uk.R: Пісня Асафа. \q Бог устає у своїй великій небесній раді. \q Він судить тих, кого там називають богами.

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: This psalm's title is short and the Hebrew counts it together with the first line as verse 1, so here the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: Asaph: a leader of the temple singers
decisions.reason: Asaph was a Levite whom David appointed to lead the singing before the ark (1 Chronicles 16:5-7); his family carried on the work. Psalms 50 and 73-83 bear his name. "Of Asaph" may mean the psalm belongs to his family's collection.

decisions.choice: the assembly of God: the divine council
decisions.reason: The phrase ('adat-'el) uses 'El, the short word for God: the gathering that belongs to God, his heavenly court. Elsewhere the same word for "assembly" is used of Israel gathered before God, and some take it so here.

decisions.choice: the gods: the members of God's heavenly council, who were to rule the nations justly
alternatives: human judges and rulers, called "gods" for their God-given office
Israel, which received God's word at Sinai
decisions.reason: The word 'elohim is plural in form. It usually means God, but it can mean gods or heavenly beings (86:8; 97:7; 138:1), and God is pictured among a council of such beings (89:6-8; 1 Kings 22:19; Job 1:6). Here God takes his stand among them and judges them for failing the poor (verses 2-4), and verse 8 hands the nations over to God himself. Many readers, ancient and modern, take the "gods" instead as human judges or rulers, who act with God's authority (compare Exodus 21:6, where 'elohim may refer to judges); Jesus quotes verse 6 of those "to whom the word of God came" (John 10:34-35). The Hebrew word itself is kept at every level as "gods".

decisions.choice: stands: takes his place as judge
decisions.reason: The verb (natsav) is to take a stand; a judge rises to give judgment (Isaiah 3:13).

decisions.choice: his great council in heaven; those there who are called gods
alternatives: the assembly of God; the gods
decisions.reason: Readable gives the reading chosen in m3 and m4 and keeps the word "gods".

decisions.choice: "miungu" (gods) for the members of God's heavenly council at every level
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads 'elohim here as the heavenly beings God set over the nations. Swahili "miungu" keeps the word the Hebrew uses, which Jesus quotes in John 10:34; Readable says they are "called gods", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "các thần" (gods), lowercase
decisions.reason: The meaning decision takes the gods as members of God's heavenly council. "các thần" says that plainly; the lowercase keeps them apart from God himself, "Đức Chúa Trời". God then speaks to them as "các người", the plain form for a rebuke, and says "Ta".

decisions.choice: "신들" for elohim as the members of the council, with no honorific; "하나님" only for God
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the gods as the members of God's heavenly council. Korean has two words where the Hebrew has one, "하나님" for God and "신들" for the others, so the difference the context makes is clear; God speaks to them in 해라체 (verses 2-7).

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Psalm 82.
alternatives: spans like the English ones (from verse 1)
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic.

decisions.choice: the gods (elohim) of the council as "አማልክት"; the assembly of El as "የእግዚአብሔር ጉባኤ" (L), "መለኮታዊው ጉባኤ" (B)
alternatives: "ዳኞች" (judges), a reading the meaning decision does not take
decisions.reason: Meaning decision m4 reads the gods as members of God's heavenly council, so Amharic keeps "አማልክት", as John 10:34 in the Amharic New Testament does at verse 6.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi. God spoken of takes the honorific plural (खड़े हैं, वे न्याय करते हैं), which already marks him apart from the "gods" around him.

decisions.choice: देवता (the gods)
decisions.reason: The gods are the members of God's heavenly council (m4). देवता is the ordinary word for "a god" and is the word of John 10:34 in this translation, which quotes verse 6; ईश्वर is not used for anyone but God.

decisions.choice: "богов" with a small letter, kept at every level
decisions.reason: The meaning decisions read "the gods" as the members of God's heavenly council; John 10:34 quotes verse 6 with the word "боги" in this translation, so every level keeps the word, and Readable says where they stand.

decisions.choice: 'adat-'el "神の集い" (L), "天の会議" (B), "天にあるご自分の大いなる会議" (R); 'elohim "神々" (L, B), "神々と呼ばれる者たち" (R); "お裁きになる" / "裁きを行われる", not 裁かれる
decisions.reason: The assembly is the divine council (m3, uncertain) and the gods its members, who were to rule the nations justly (m4, uncertain, footnoted in the English); 裁かれる would read as a passive (PSA-6).

records.literal_gloss: Until when will you judge injustice and [the] face of wicked [people] lift up? Selah.

en.L: "Until when will you judge unjustly \q and lift up the face of [the] wicked? Selah
en.B: "How long will you judge unfairly \q and take the side of the wicked? Selah
en.R: "How long will you keep judging unfairly? \q How long will you favor wicked people? Selah

fr.L: « Jusqu’à quand jugerez-vous injustement \q et soulèverez-vous la face des méchants ? Sélah
fr.B: « Jusqu’à quand jugerez-vous de façon injuste \q et prendrez-vous le parti des méchants ? Sélah
fr.R: « Combien de temps allez-vous encore juger injustement ? \q Combien de temps allez-vous favoriser les méchants ? Sélah

sw.B: "Mpaka lini mtahukumu bila haki \q na kuwapendelea waovu? Sela
sw.R: "Mpaka lini mtaendelea kuhukumu bila haki? \q Mpaka lini mtawapendelea watu waovu? Sela

es.L: «¿Hasta cuándo {{plural_you:juzgarán|juzgaréis}} injustamente \q y {{plural_you:levantarán|levantaréis}} el rostro de [los] malvados? Selah
es.B: «¿Hasta cuándo {{plural_you:juzgarán|juzgaréis}} con injusticia \q y {{plural_you:tomarán|tomaréis}} partido por los malvados? Selah
es.R: «¿Hasta cuándo {{plural_you:seguirán|seguiréis}} juzgando injustamente? \q ¿Hasta cuándo {{plural_you:favorecerán|favoreceréis}} a los malvados? Selah

vi.L: "Cho đến bao giờ các người còn xét xử bất công \q và nâng mặt [những kẻ] ác lên? Sê-la
vi.B: "Các người còn xét xử bất công \q và bênh vực kẻ ác cho đến bao giờ? Sê-la
vi.R: "Các người còn xét xử bất công đến bao giờ? \q Các người còn thiên vị kẻ ác đến bao giờ? Sê-la

ko.L: "언제까지 너희가 불의하게 재판하고, \q 악인들의 얼굴을 들어 주겠느냐? 셀라
ko.B: "너희가 언제까지 불공정하게 재판하고, \q 악인들의 편을 들겠느냐? 셀라
ko.R: "너희가 언제까지 불공평하게 재판하겠느냐? \q 언제까지 악한 사람들의 편을 들겠느냐? 셀라

pt.L: "Até quando vocês julgarão injustamente \q e levantarão o rosto dos ímpios? Selá
pt.B: "Até quando vocês vão julgar com injustiça \q e tomar o partido dos ímpios? Selá
pt.R: "Até quando vocês vão continuar julgando com injustiça? \q Até quando vão favorecer gente má? Selá

am.L: «እስከ መቼ በዓመፅ ትፈርዳላችሁ? \q የኃጥኣንንስ ፊት [እስከ መቼ] ታነሣላችሁ? ሴላ
am.B: «እስከ መቼ በግፍ ትፈርዳላችሁ? \q እስከ መቼስ ለክፉዎች ታደላላችሁ? ሴላ
am.R: «እስከ መቼ ያለ ፍትሕ ትፈርዳላችሁ? \q እስከ መቼስ ክፉ ሰዎችን ትደግፋላችሁ? ሴላ

hi.L: "तुम कब तक अन्याय से न्याय करोगे \q और दुष्टों का मुँह देखा करोगे? सेला
hi.B: "तुम कब तक अन्याय से न्याय करते रहोगे \q और दुष्टों का पक्ष लेते रहोगे? सेला
hi.R: "तुम कब तक अन्याय से फ़ैसले करते रहोगे? \q कब तक दुष्ट लोगों का पक्ष लेते रहोगे? सेला

ru.B: «Сколько ещё вы будете судить несправедливо \q и становиться на сторону нечестивых? Села
ru.R: «Сколько ещё вы будете судить нечестно? \q Сколько ещё вы будете угождать злым людям? Села

ja.R: 「いつまで、あなたたちは不公平な裁きを続けるのか？ \q いつまで、悪い人たちをひいきするのか？セラ

uk.L: «Доки ви судитимете несправедливо \q і підноситимете обличчя нечестивих? Села
uk.B: «Доки ви судитимете нечесно \q й ставатимете на бік нечестивих? Села
uk.R: «Доки ви судитимете несправедливо? \q Доки ви будете на боці злих людей? Села

decisions.choice: God speaks, to verse 7
decisions.reason: God's words to the gods begin here and run to verse 7; the quotation stays open until then. Verse 5 may be an aside about them.

decisions.choice: lift up the face of: show favor to
decisions.reason: To lift someone's face is to accept them, here to be partial to them in judgment, which the law forbids (Leviticus 19:15; Deuteronomy 10:17).

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: God speaks to the gods with "vous"
decisions.reason: God addresses the whole council (meaning decision m1), so French uses the plural "vous", as it does to any group.

decisions.choice: plural you (ustedes / vosotros) in verses 2-7
decisions.reason: In verses 2-7 God speaks to the gods of his council as a group; the Hebrew verbs are plural. Spanish marks every one of these verbs and pronouns with the plural "you" setting.

decisions.choice: vocês (God to the gods)
decisions.reason: God speaks to the members of the council as a group (plural verbs), so he says "vocês", as God speaks to a group in the Old Testament terms; "vós" is not used.

decisions.choice: तुम from God to the gods
decisions.reason: God speaks to the gods of his council (verses 2-7). As always when God speaks, he says तुम.

decisions.choice: God's speech 「 82:2 … 」 82:7 to the gods, plural あなたがた (L, B), あなたたち (R); nas'u-panim "顔を上げる" (L), "肩を持つ" (B), "ひいきする" (R)
decisions.reason: God speaks to the council to verse 7 (m1); lifting up the face is showing favor (m2).

records.literal_gloss: Judge [the] poor and fatherless; [the] afflicted and needy vindicate.

en.L: Judge [for the] poor and [the] fatherless; \q vindicate [the] afflicted and [the] destitute.
en.B: Judge fairly for the weak and for orphans; \q declare the afflicted and the destitute in the right.
en.R: Stand up for poor people and for children who have no father. \q Do what is right for people who are suffering and in need.

fr.L: Jugez [pour le] faible et [l’]orphelin ; \q rendez justice à [l’]humble et [à l’]indigent.
fr.B: Faites droit au faible et à l’orphelin ; \q déclarez justes l’humble et le démuni.
fr.R: Défendez les pauvres et les enfants qui n’ont pas de père. \q Faites ce qui est juste pour ceux qui souffrent et qui sont dans le besoin.

sw.L: Mhukumuni [kwa haki] maskini na yatima; \q mtendeeni haki mnyonge na fukara.
sw.B: Wahukumuni kwa haki wanyonge na yatima; \q watangazeni wanaoteseka na fukara kuwa hawana hatia.
sw.R: Watetee watu maskini na watoto wasio na baba. \q Watendeeni haki watu wanaoteseka na wenye mahitaji.

es.L: {{plural_you:Juzguen|Juzgad}} [a favor del] pobre y [del] huérfano; \q {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} justicia al afligido y al menesteroso.
es.B: {{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} justicia al débil y al huérfano; \q {{plural_you:defiendan|defended}} el derecho del afligido y del menesteroso.
es.R: {{plural_you:Defiendan|Defended}} a los pobres y a los niños que no tienen padre. \q {{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} lo correcto por los que sufren y pasan necesidad.

vi.L: Hãy xét xử [cho người] nghèo và [kẻ] mồ côi; \q hãy minh oan cho [người] khốn khổ và [người] cùng quẫn.
vi.B: Hãy xét xử công bằng cho người yếu thế và trẻ mồ côi; \q hãy xử cho người khốn khổ và người cùng quẫn được lẽ phải.
vi.R: Hãy bênh vực người nghèo và trẻ mồ côi cha. \q Hãy làm điều đúng cho những người đang đau khổ và thiếu thốn.

ko.L: 가난한 자와 고아를 위해 재판하고, \q 고난받는 자와 빈궁한 자를 의롭다 하여라.
ko.B: 약한 사람과 고아를 공정하게 재판하고, \q 고난받는 사람과 빈궁한 사람의 권리를 찾아 주어라.
ko.R: 가난한 사람들과 아버지 없는 아이들의 편이 되어 주어라. \q 고통받고 어려운 사람들에게 옳은 일을 하여라.

pt.L: Julguem [a favor do] fraco e [do] órfão; \q declarem justos [o] aflito e [o] desamparado.
pt.B: Façam justiça ao fraco e ao órfão; \q declarem que o aflito e o desamparado estão com a razão.
pt.R: Defendam os pobres e as crianças que não têm pai. \q Façam o que é certo para quem está sofrendo e passa necessidade.

am.L: ለድሀውና ለድሀ አደጉ ፍረዱ፤ \q ለጐስቋላውና ለችግረኛው ጽድቅን አድርጉ።
am.B: ለደካማውና ለድሀ አደጉ በትክክል ፍረዱ፤ \q ለተጨቆነውና ለችግረኛው ፍትሕ አድርጉ።
am.R: ለድሆችና አባት ለሌላቸው ልጆች ቁሙላቸው። \q ለሚሠቃዩትና ለተቸገሩት ትክክለኛውን አድርጉ።

hi.L: ग़रीब और अनाथ का न्याय करो; \q दीन और कंगाल को निर्दोष ठहराओ।
hi.B: कमज़ोर और अनाथ का सच्चा न्याय करो; \q दीन और कंगाल को सही ठहराओ।
hi.R: ग़रीबों और उन बच्चों का पक्ष लो जिनके पिता नहीं हैं। \q जो दुख में हैं और ज़रूरतमंद हैं, उनके लिए वह करो जो सही है।

ru.L: Судите бедного и сироту; \q угнетённого и нищего оправдывайте.
ru.B: Судите справедливо слабого и сироту; \q признавайте правыми угнетённого и нищего.
ru.R: Заступайтесь за бедных и за детей, у которых нет отца. \q Поступайте справедливо с теми, кто страдает и нуждается.

ja.L: 弱い者とみなしごのために裁きなさい。 \q 苦しむ者と困窮する者を、正しいとしなさい。
ja.B: 弱い者と父のいない子のために、正しく裁きなさい。 \q 苦しむ者と困窮する者を、正しいと認めなさい。
ja.R: 貧しい人たちや、父のいない子どもたちの味方になりなさい。 \q 苦しんでいる人たち、困っている人たちのために、正しいことをしなさい。

uk.L: Судіть [за] бідного й сироту; \q виправдовуйте пригнобленого й злиденного.
uk.B: Судіть справедливо слабких і сиріт; \q визнавайте правоту пригноблених і злиденних.
uk.R: Заступайтеся за бідних і за дітей, у яких немає батька. \q Робіть те, що правильно, для людей, які страждають і бідують.

decisions.choice: judge for: defend the cause of
decisions.reason: To "judge" someone in this sense is to give them justice and take up their case (10:18; Isaiah 1:17).

decisions.choice: vindicate: declare in the right
decisions.reason: The verb (tsadaq, causative) is a judge's verdict that someone is in the right (Deuteronomy 25:1).

decisions.choice: the poor and the fatherless
decisions.reason: Those with no one to defend them were the special care of judges and kings, and of God himself (68:6; Deuteronomy 10:18).

decisions.choice: dal "弱い者" (L, B), "貧しい人たち" (R); yatom "みなしご" (L), "父のいない子" (B, R); 'ani "苦しむ者"; rash "困窮する者" (L, B), "困っている人たち" (R); hatsdiqu "正しいとしなさい" (L), "正しいと認めなさい" (B)
decisions.reason: Judge for is defend the cause of (m1); vindicate is declare in the right (m2). The Psalter's words for the poor (PSA-1); God's commands 〜なさい.

records.literal_gloss: Rescue [the] poor and needy; from [the] hand of wicked [people] deliver.

en.L: Rescue [the] poor and [the] needy; \q deliver [them] from the hand of [the] wicked.
en.B: Bring the weak and the poor to safety; \q snatch them from the grip of the wicked.
en.R: Save poor people and needy people. \q Pull them out of the power of evil people.

fr.L: Délivrez [le] faible et [l’]indigent ; \q arrachez-[les] à la main des méchants.
fr.B: Mettez à l’abri le faible et le pauvre ; \q arrachez-les à la poigne des méchants.
fr.R: Sauvez les pauvres et ceux qui sont dans le besoin. \q Tirez-les du pouvoir des méchants.

sw.L: Mwokoeni maskini na mhitaji; \q [mwa]ponyeni na mkono wa waovu.
sw.B: Wapelekeni wanyonge na maskini mahali salama; \q wanyakueni kutoka katika mshiko wa waovu.
sw.R: Waokoeni watu maskini na wenye mahitaji. \q Watoeni katika mikono ya watu waovu.

es.L: {{plural_you:Rescaten|Rescatad}} al pobre y al necesitado; \q {{plural_you:líbrenlos|libradlos}} de la mano de [los] malvados.
es.B: {{plural_you:Pongan|Poned}} a salvo al débil y al pobre; \q {{plural_you:arrebátenlos|arrebatadlos}} de las garras de los malvados.
es.R: {{plural_you:Salven|Salvad}} a los pobres y a los necesitados. \q {{plural_you:Sáquenlos|Sacadlos}} del poder de los malvados.

vi.L: Hãy giải cứu [người] nghèo và [người] thiếu thốn; \q hãy giải thoát [họ] khỏi tay [những kẻ] ác.
vi.B: Hãy đưa người yếu thế và người nghèo đến nơi an toàn; \q hãy giật họ ra khỏi nanh vuốt kẻ ác.
vi.R: Hãy cứu người nghèo và người thiếu thốn. \q Hãy kéo họ ra khỏi quyền lực của kẻ ác.

ko.L: 가난한 자와 궁핍한 자를 구하고, \q 악인들의 손에서 [그들을] 건져라.
ko.B: 약한 사람과 가난한 사람을 안전한 곳으로 데려가고, \q 악인들의 손아귀에서 그들을 빼내라.
ko.R: 가난한 사람들과 도움이 필요한 사람들을 구해 주어라. \q 악한 사람들의 손에서 그들을 건져 내어라.

pt.L: Livrem [o] fraco e [o] necessitado; \q da mão dos ímpios libertem-[nos].
pt.B: Ponham em segurança o fraco e o pobre; \q arranquem-nos das garras dos ímpios.
pt.R: Salvem os pobres e os necessitados. \q Tirem essas pessoas do poder de gente má.

am.L: ድሀውንና ምስኪኑን አድኑ፤ \q ከኃጥኣን እጅ አውጡ።
am.B: ደካማውንና ድሀውን ወደ ደኅንነት አውጡ፤ \q ከክፉዎች እጅ ንጠቋቸው።
am.R: ድሆችንና የተቸገሩትን አድኑ። \q ከክፉ ሰዎች ኃይል አውጧቸው።

hi.L: ग़रीब और दरिद्र को छुड़ाओ; \q दुष्टों के हाथ से [उन्हें] बचाओ।
hi.B: कमज़ोर और दरिद्र को सुरक्षित स्थान पर पहुँचाओ; \q उन्हें दुष्टों की पकड़ से छीन लो।
hi.R: ग़रीब और ज़रूरतमंद लोगों को बचाओ। \q उन्हें बुरे लोगों के वश से निकालो।

ru.L: Спасайте бедного и нищего; \q избавляйте [их] из руки нечестивых.
ru.B: Выводите слабого и бедного в безопасное место; \q вырывайте их из рук нечестивых.
ru.R: Спасайте бедных и нуждающихся. \q Вырывайте их из власти злых людей.

ja.L: 弱い者と乏しい者を助け出しなさい。 \q 悪しき者たちの手から、救い出しなさい。
ja.B: 弱い者と貧しい者を、安全な所へ逃がしなさい。 \q 悪しき者たちの手から、彼らを奪い返しなさい。
ja.R: 貧しい人たち、困っている人たちを救いなさい。 \q 悪い人たちの力から、彼らを引き出しなさい。

uk.L: Рятуйте бідного й убогого; \q визволяйте [їх] з руки нечестивих.
uk.B: Виведіть слабких і бідних у безпеку; \q вирвіть їх із лап нечестивих.
uk.R: Рятуйте бідних і нужденних. \q Визволяйте їх із влади злих людей.

decisions.choice: the hand: the power
decisions.reason: The hand stands for power and control (31:16).

decisions.choice: 'evyon "乏しい者" (L), "貧しい者" (B), "困っている人たち" (R); miyyad "手から" (L, B), "力から" (R)
decisions.reason: The hand is the power (m1), which R says plainly.

source.text: לֹ֤א יָֽדְע֨וּ׀וְלֹ֥א יָבִ֗ינוּ בַּחֲשֵׁכָ֥ה יִתְהַלָּ֑כוּ יִ֝מּ֗וֹטוּ כָּל־מ֥וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Not they know and not they understand; in darkness they walk about; are shaken all [the] foundations of [the] earth.

en.L: They do not know and do not understand; \q in darkness they walk about; \q all [the] foundations of [the] earth are shaken.
en.B: They have no knowledge and no understanding; \q they wander around in the dark, \q and the earth's foundations all totter.
en.R: They know nothing. They understand nothing. \q They walk around in the dark, \q and everything the world stands on is shaking.

fr.L: Ils ne savent pas et ne comprennent pas ; \q dans les ténèbres ils vont et viennent ; \q tous [les] fondements de [la] terre sont ébranlés.
fr.B: Ils n’ont ni connaissance ni intelligence ; \q ils errent dans l’obscurité, \q et les fondations de la terre chancellent toutes.
fr.R: Ils ne savent rien. Ils ne comprennent rien. \q Ils marchent dans le noir, \q et tout ce qui tient le monde debout est en train de trembler.

sw.L: Hawajui wala hawafahamu; \q wanatembea gizani; \q misingi yote ya dunia inatikisika.
sw.B: Hawana maarifa wala ufahamu; \q wanatangatanga gizani, \q na misingi ya dunia yote inayumba.
sw.R: Hawajui kitu. Hawaelewi kitu. \q Wanatembea gizani, \q na kila kitu ambacho dunia inasimama juu yake kinatikisika.

es.L: No saben ni entienden; \q andan en tinieblas; \q todos [los] cimientos de [la] tierra se estremecen.
es.B: No tienen conocimiento ni entendimiento; \q andan de un lado a otro en la oscuridad, \q y todos los cimientos de la tierra se tambalean.
es.R: No saben nada. No entienden nada. \q Andan en la oscuridad, \q y todo lo que sostiene al mundo se está sacudiendo.

vi.L: Chúng không biết và không hiểu; \q chúng đi lại trong bóng tối; \q mọi nền móng của đất đều rúng động.
vi.B: Chúng chẳng có tri thức, cũng chẳng có sự hiểu biết; \q chúng đi lang thang trong bóng tối, \q và mọi nền móng của đất đều lung lay.
vi.R: Chúng chẳng biết gì. Chúng chẳng hiểu gì. \q Chúng đi loanh quanh trong bóng tối, \q và mọi thứ nâng đỡ thế giới đều đang rung chuyển.

ko.L: 그들은 알지 못하고 깨닫지 못하며, \q 어둠 속에서 돌아다닌다. \q 땅의 모든 기초가 흔들린다.
ko.B: 그들은 아는 것도 없고 깨닫는 것도 없이 \q 어둠 속을 헤매니, \q 땅의 기초가 모두 흔들린다.
ko.R: 그들은 아무것도 모른다. 아무것도 깨닫지 못한다. \q 어둠 속을 돌아다닌다. \q 그래서 세상을 떠받치는 모든 것이 흔들리고 있다.

pt.L: Não sabem e não entendem; \q nas trevas andam de um lado para outro; \q todos os fundamentos da terra se abalam.
pt.B: Eles não têm conhecimento nem entendimento; \q vagueiam na escuridão, \q e todos os alicerces da terra cambaleiam.
pt.R: Eles não sabem nada. Não entendem nada. \q Andam no escuro, \q e tudo aquilo em que o mundo se apoia está tremendo.

am.L: አያውቁም፤ አያስተውሉምም፤ \q በጨለማ ይመላለሳሉ፤ \q የምድር መሠረቶች ሁሉ ይናወጣሉ።
am.B: እውቀት የላቸውም፤ ማስተዋልም የላቸውም፤ \q በጨለማ ውስጥ ይንከራተታሉ፤ \q የምድር መሠረቶችም ሁሉ ይንገዳገዳሉ።
am.R: ምንም አያውቁም። ምንም አያስተውሉም። \q በጨለማ ውስጥ ይመላለሳሉ፤ \q ዓለም የቆመችበትም ሁሉ ይናወጣል።

hi.L: वे न तो जानते हैं और न समझते हैं; \q वे अंधकार में चलते-फिरते हैं; \q पृथ्वी की सारी नींवें डगमगा जाती हैं।
hi.B: उन्हें न ज्ञान है न समझ; \q वे अंधेरे में भटकते फिरते हैं, \q और पृथ्वी की सब नींवें हिल रही हैं।
hi.R: वे कुछ नहीं जानते। वे कुछ नहीं समझते। \q वे अंधेरे में घूमते हैं, \q और जिस पर संसार टिका है वह सब हिल रहा है।

ru.L: Не знают и не понимают; \q во тьме ходят; \q колеблются все основания земли.
ru.B: У них нет ни знания, ни понимания; \q они бродят во тьме, \q и все основания земли шатаются.
ru.R: Они ничего не знают. Они ничего не понимают. \q Они ходят в темноте, \q и всё, на чём стоит мир, колеблется.

ja.L: 彼らは知らず、悟らない。 \q 闇の中を歩き回る。 \q 地のすべての基は揺らぐ。
ja.B: 彼らには知識もなく、悟りもない。 \q 闇の中をさまよい歩き、 \q 地の基はことごとく揺らいでいる。
ja.R: 彼らは何も知らない。何もわかっていない。 \q 暗やみの中を歩き回っている。 \q そして、世界を支えているものすべてが揺れている。

uk.L: Вони не знають і не розуміють; \q у темряві вони ходять; \q хитаються всі основи землі.
uk.B: Вони не мають ні знання, ні розуміння; \q вони блукають у темряві, \q і всі основи землі хитаються.
uk.R: Вони нічого не знають. Вони нічого не розуміють. \q Вони ходять у темряві, \q і все, на чому стоїть світ, хитається.

decisions.choice: they: the gods who judge unjustly
alternatives: the oppressed, who do not know where to turn
decisions.reason: "They" most likely means the gods addressed in verses 2-4, described now in the third person, as a judge might turn to the court. It can also mean the wicked.

decisions.choice: the foundations of the earth are shaken: the world's order fails
decisions.reason: Justice holds the world together (75:4; 11:3). When those who should rule justly do not, the whole order of creation totters.

decisions.choice: "彼ら" left as the Hebrew has it; mosedei 'erets "地の基" (L, B), "世界を支えているもの" (R)
decisions.reason: They are the gods who judge unjustly (m1, uncertain); the shaken foundations are the world's order failing (m2).

source.text: אֲֽנִי־אָ֭מַרְתִּי אֱלֹהִ֣ים אַתֶּ֑ם וּבְנֵ֖י עֶלְי֣וֹן כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: I said, Gods [are] you, and sons of [the] Most High, all of you.

en.L: I said, 'You [are] gods, \q and sons of the Most High, all of you.'
en.B: I myself said, 'You are gods; \q every one of you is a son of the Most High.'
en.R: I said, 'You are gods. \q Each of you is a son of the God who is above all.'

fr.L: Moi, j’ai dit : “Vous [êtes] des dieux, \q et des fils du Très-Haut, vous tous.”
fr.B: C’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui l’ai dit : “Vous êtes des dieux ; \q chacun de vous est un fils du Très-Haut.”
fr.R: J’ai dit : “Vous êtes des dieux. \q Chacun de vous est un fils du Dieu qui est au-dessus de tout.”

sw.L: Mimi nilisema, 'Ninyi [ni] miungu, \q na wana wa Aliye Juu Kabisa, nyote.'
sw.B: Mimi mwenyewe nilisema, 'Ninyi ni miungu; \q kila mmoja wenu ni mwana wa Aliye Juu Kabisa.'
sw.R: Nilisema, 'Ninyi ni miungu. \q Kila mmoja wenu ni mwana wa Mungu aliye juu ya wote.'

es.L: Yo dije: “{{plural_you:Ustedes [son]|Vosotros [sois]}} dioses, \q e hijos del Altísimo, todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}”.
es.B: Yo mismo dije: “{{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} dioses; \q cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} es hijo del Altísimo”.
es.R: Yo dije: “{{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} dioses. \q Cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} es hijo del Dios que está por encima de todo”.

vi.L: Ta đã phán: 'Các người [là] thần, \q và tất cả các người [là] con của Đấng Chí Cao.'
vi.B: Chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán: 'Các người là thần; \q mỗi người trong các người đều là con của Đấng Chí Cao.'
vi.R: Ta đã phán: 'Các người là thần. \q Mỗi người trong các người là con của Đức Chúa Trời ở trên hết mọi sự.'

ko.L: 내가 말하였다. '너희는 신들[이며], \q 너희 모두가 지극히 높은 이의 아들들이다.'
ko.B: 내가 친히 말했다. '너희는 신들이다. \q 너희는 모두 지극히 높은 이의 아들들이다.'
ko.R: 내가 말했다. '너희는 신들이다. \q 너희는 모두 모든 것 위에 있는 하나님의 아들들이다.'

pt.L: Eu disse: 'Vocês [são] deuses, \q e filhos do Altíssimo, todos vocês.'
pt.B: Eu mesmo disse: 'Vocês são deuses; \q cada um de vocês é filho do Altíssimo.'
pt.R: Eu disse: 'Vocês são deuses. \q Cada um de vocês é filho do Deus que está acima de tudo.'

am.L: እኔ፦ “አማልክት ናችሁ፤ \q ሁላችሁም የልዑል ልጆች [ናችሁ]” አልኩ።
am.B: እኔ ራሴ፦ “አማልክት ናችሁ፤ \q እያንዳንዳችሁም የልዑል ልጆች ናችሁ” አልኩ።
am.R: እኔ፦ “አማልክት ናችሁ። \q እያንዳንዳችሁም ከሁሉ በላይ የሆነው አምላክ ልጆች ናችሁ” አልኩ።

hi.L: मैंने कहा, 'तुम देवता [हो], \q और तुम सब परमप्रधान के पुत्र [हो]।'
hi.B: मैंने ही कहा था, 'तुम देवता हो; \q तुममें से हर एक परमप्रधान का पुत्र है।'
hi.R: मैंने कहा, 'तुम देवता हो। \q तुममें से हर एक उस परमेश्वर का पुत्र है जो सबसे ऊपर हैं।'

ru.L: Я сказал: “Вы — боги, \q и сыны Всевышнего — все вы.”
ru.B: Я сказал: “Вы — боги; \q каждый из вас — сын Всевышнего.”
ru.R: Я сказал: “Вы — боги. \q Каждый из вас — сын Бога, который выше всех.”

ja.L: わたしは言った。『あなたがたは神々である。 \q あなたがたはみな、いと高き方の子らである。』
ja.B: わたしは、確かに言った。『あなたがたは神々である。 \q あなたがたはみな、いと高き方の子である。』
ja.R: わたしは言った。『あなたたちは神々だ。 \q あなたたちはみな、すべてのものの上に立つ神の子だ。』

uk.L: Я сказав: “Ви — боги, \q і сини Всевишнього всі ви.”
uk.B: Я сам сказав: “Ви — боги; \q кожен із вас — син Всевишнього.”
uk.R: Я сказав: “Ви — боги. \q Кожен із вас — син Бога, який вищий за все.”

decisions.choice: the gods: the members of God's heavenly council, who were to rule the nations justly
alternatives: human judges and rulers, called "gods" for their God-given office
Israel, which received God's word at Sinai
decisions.reason: As in verse 1. God himself gave them their high place. Jesus quotes these words in John 10:34-36, arguing that if the law calls "gods" those to whom God's word came, he does not blaspheme in calling himself God's Son.

decisions.choice: John 10:34
decisions.reason: Jesus quotes "I said, you are gods" as words written in the law, meaning the Scriptures as a whole.

decisions.choice: sons of the Most High: beings who belong to God's realm
decisions.reason: "Sons of" marks belonging to a class. The "sons of God" are heavenly beings in Job 1:6 and 38:7; the phrase marks the gods' rank under the Most High.

decisions.choice: the Most High: God above all
decisions.reason: The title ('Elyon) names God as the highest over all (Genesis 14:19; 7:18).

decisions.choice: the God who is above all
decisions.reason: Readable says what the title means (m4).

decisions.choice: Eu disse: 'Vocês são deuses'
decisions.reason: Jesus quotes these words in John 10:34 (m2), whose Portuguese reads "Eu disse: 'Vocês são deuses'"; the psalm keeps the same words at every level so that a reader recognizes the quotation. "Filhos" needs no gender setting: these are heavenly beings, and "filhos" already reads generally.

decisions.choice: «እኔ፦ ‘አማልክት ናችሁ’ አልኩ», as Jesus quotes it in John 10:34 in the Amharic New Testament, with the quotation inside God's speech in “ ”
decisions.reason: The Greek of John 10:34 agrees with the Hebrew here, so the psalm keeps the New Testament's words and their order, with "አልኩ" after the quotation.

decisions.choice: मैंने कहा, 'तुम देवता हो'
decisions.reason: Jesus quotes these words in John 10:34, and the Hindi of John has मैंने कहा, "तुम देवता हो" at every level. The Hebrew says the same, so the psalm keeps that wording; Literal brackets हो, which the Hebrew leaves unspoken.

decisions.choice: "Я сказал: “Вы — боги”", as John 10:34
decisions.reason: Jesus quotes this line in John 10:34, and the Hebrew says the same as the Greek there, so every level keeps the Russian of that quotation in this translation, "Я сказал: ‘Вы — боги’", with the inner quotation marks this verse needs inside God's speech. "Всевышний" is the poetry note's form for 'Elyon.

decisions.choice: 'elohim 'attem "あなたがたは神々である" (L, B), "あなたたちは神々だ" (R), as JHN 10:34; 'Elyon "いと高き方" (L, B), R "すべてのものの上に立つ神" without a respect form, as 50:14 in God's own mouth
decisions.reason: Jesus quotes this line in John 10:34 (m2), and the Hebrew agrees with that Greek, so the Japanese follows the John Japanese at each level; the Most High is God above all (m4).

source.text: אָ֭כֵן כְּאָדָ֣ם תְּמוּת֑וּן וּכְאַחַ֖ד הַשָּׂרִ֣ים תִּפֹּֽלוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Nevertheless like humankind you will die, and like one of the princes you will fall.

en.L: Nevertheless like humankind you will die, \q and like one of the princes you will fall."
en.B: Yet you will die as human beings die, \q and fall like any one of the princes."
en.R: But you will die the way people die. \q You will fall like any ruler."

fr.L: Cependant, comme les humains vous mourrez, \q et comme l’un des princes vous tomberez. »
fr.B: Pourtant vous mourrez comme meurent les humains, \q et vous tomberez comme n’importe quel prince. »
fr.R: Mais vous mourrez comme meurent les gens. \q Vous tomberez comme n’importe quel chef. »

sw.L: Lakini mtakufa kama wanadamu, \q na kuanguka kama mmoja wa wakuu."
sw.B: Hata hivyo mtakufa kama wanadamu wanavyokufa, \q na kuanguka kama mkuu yeyote."
sw.R: Lakini mtakufa kama watu wanavyokufa. \q Mtaanguka kama mtawala yeyote."

es.L: Sin embargo, como los humanos {{plural_you:morirán|moriréis}}, \q y como uno de los príncipes {{plural_you:caerán|caeréis}}».
es.B: Pero {{plural_you:morirán|moriréis}} como mueren los seres humanos, \q y {{plural_you:caerán|caeréis}} como cualquiera de los príncipes».
es.R: Pero {{plural_you:morirán|moriréis}} como muere la gente. \q {{plural_you:Caerán|Caeréis}} como cualquier gobernante».

vi.L: Tuy nhiên các người sẽ chết như loài người, \q và sẽ ngã xuống như một trong các vương hầu."
vi.B: Nhưng các người sẽ chết như loài người phải chết, \q và ngã xuống như bất cứ vương hầu nào."
vi.R: Nhưng các người sẽ chết như người ta chết. \q Các người sẽ ngã xuống như bất cứ kẻ cai trị nào."

ko.L: 그러나 너희는 사람처럼 죽고, \q 통치자들 가운데 하나처럼 쓰러질 것이다."
ko.B: 그러나 너희는 사람들이 죽듯이 죽고, \q 여느 통치자처럼 쓰러질 것이다."
ko.R: 그러나 너희는 사람들이 죽는 것처럼 죽을 것이다. \q 여느 통치자처럼 쓰러질 것이다."

pt.L: Contudo, como [os] humanos vocês morrerão, \q e como um dos príncipes vocês cairão."
pt.B: Mas vocês morrerão como morrem os seres humanos \q e cairão como qualquer um dos príncipes."
pt.R: Mas vocês vão morrer como as pessoas morrem. \q Vão cair como qualquer governante."

am.L: ነገር ግን እንደ ሰው ትሞታላችሁ፤ \q ከአለቆችም እንደ አንዱ ትወድቃላችሁ።»
am.B: ይሁን እንጂ ሰዎች እንደሚሞቱ ትሞታላችሁ፤ \q ከአለቆችም እንደ አንዱ ትወድቃላችሁ።»
am.R: ነገር ግን ሰዎች በሚሞቱበት መንገድ ትሞታላችሁ። \q እንደ ማንኛውም ገዥ ትወድቃላችሁ።»

hi.L: तौभी तुम मनुष्यों के समान मरोगे, \q और हाकिमों में से किसी एक के समान गिरोगे।"
hi.B: फिर भी तुम वैसे ही मरोगे जैसे मनुष्य मरते हैं, \q और किसी भी हाकिम के समान गिर पड़ोगे।"
hi.R: पर तुम वैसे ही मरोगे जैसे लोग मरते हैं। \q तुम किसी भी शासक की तरह गिर जाओगे।"

ru.L: Однако вы умрёте, как люди, \q и падёте, как любой из князей.»
ru.B: И всё же вы умрёте, как умирают люди, \q и падёте, как любой из правителей.»
ru.R: Но вы умрёте так, как умирают люди. \q Вы падёте, как падает любой правитель.»

ja.L: しかし、あなたがたは人のように死に、 \q 君主たちの一人のように倒れる。」
ja.B: しかし、あなたがたは、人が死ぬように死に、 \q どの君主とも同じように倒れる。」
ja.R: しかし、あなたたちは、人間と同じように死ぬ。 \q どんな支配者とも同じように倒れる。」

uk.L: Проте ви помрете, як людина, \q і впадете, як один із князів.»
uk.B: Але ви помрете, як помирають люди, \q і впадете, як будь-хто з князів.»
uk.R: Але ви помрете так, як помирають люди. \q Ви впадете, як будь-який правитель.»

decisions.choice: like humankind: as mortals do
decisions.reason: The word ('adam) means human beings, or the first man, Adam, who was made to die (Genesis 3:19). Their high rank will not save them from death.

decisions.choice: the princes: rulers who fall
decisions.reason: The princes are rulers, whose fall from power was common. Some read "one of the princes" as a heavenly being cast down (compare Isaiah 14:12-15).

decisions.choice: nevertheless: in spite of their rank
decisions.reason: The word ('akhen) turns against what was just said: though they are gods, they will die. God's speech ends here.

decisions.choice: ke'adam "人のように" (L), "人が死ぬように" (B), "人間と同じように" (R); hassarim "君主たち" (L, B), "支配者" (R)
decisions.reason: Like humankind is as mortals do (m1, uncertain); the princes are rulers who fall (m2, uncertain).

source.text: קוּמָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים שָׁפְטָ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה תִ֝נְחַ֗ל בְּכָל־הַגּוֹיִֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you, you will inherit among all the nations.

en.L: Arise, God, judge the earth, \q for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will take possession of all the nations.
en.B: Rise up, God, judge the earth, \q since every nation belongs to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: Get up, God! Judge the whole world, \q because all the nations are {{deity_pronoun:yours|Yours}}.

fr.L: Lève-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, ô Dieu, juge la terre, \q car {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} prendras possession de toutes les nations.
fr.B: Lève-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, ô Dieu, juge la terre, \q puisque toutes les nations {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appartiennent.
fr.R: Lève-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, Dieu ! Juge le monde entier, \q car toutes les nations sont à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Inuka, Ee Mungu, uihukumu dunia, \q kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} utayamiliki mataifa yote.
sw.B: Simama, Ee Mungu, uihukumu dunia, \q kwa kuwa kila taifa ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Inuka, Mungu! Uuhukumu ulimwengu wote, \q kwa sababu mataifa yote ni {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

es.L: Levántate, oh Dios, juzga la tierra, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} tomarás posesión de todas las naciones.
es.B: Levántate, oh Dios, juzga la tierra, \q pues todas las naciones {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} pertenecen.
es.R: ¡Levántate, Dios! Juzga al mundo entero, \q porque todas las naciones son {{deity_pronoun:tuyas|Tuyas}}.

vi.L: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin trỗi dậy, xin xét xử trái đất, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ nhận mọi dân tộc làm sản nghiệp.
vi.B: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin đứng dậy xét xử trái đất, \q vì mọi dân tộc đều thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin hãy đứng dậy! Xin xét xử cả thế giới, \q vì mọi dân tộc đều thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 하나님, 일어나셔서 땅을 심판하십시오. \q 주님께서 모든 민족을 차지하실 것이기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 하나님, 일어나셔서 땅을 심판하십시오. \q 모든 민족이 주님의 것이기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 하나님, 일어나십시오! 온 세상을 심판해 주십시오. \q 모든 민족이 주님의 것입니다.

pt.L: Levanta-te, Deus, julga a terra, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} tomarás posse de todas as nações.
pt.B: Levanta-te, Deus, julga a terra, \q pois todas as nações pertencem a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.R: Levanta-te, Deus! Julga o mundo inteiro, \q porque todas as nações são {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}}.

am.L: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ተነሥ፤ በምድር ላይ ፍረድ፤ \q አንተ ሕዝቦችን ሁሉ ትወርሳለህና።
am.B: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ተነሥ፤ በምድር ላይ ፍረድ፤ \q ሕዝቦች ሁሉ የአንተ ናቸውና።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ተነሥ! በዓለም ሁሉ ላይ ፍረድ፤ \q ሕዝቦች ሁሉ የአንተ ናቸውና።

hi.L: हे परमेश्वर, उठ, पृथ्वी का न्याय कर, \q क्योंकि तू ही सब जातियों को अपनी निज संपत्ति बनाएगा।
hi.B: हे परमेश्वर, उठ, पृथ्वी का न्याय कर, \q क्योंकि हर राष्ट्र तेरा ही है।
hi.R: हे परमेश्वर, उठ! सारे संसार का न्याय कर, \q क्योंकि सब देश तेरे हैं।

ru.L: Встань, Боже, суди землю, \q потому что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} получишь во владение все народы.
ru.B: Восстань, Боже, суди землю, \q ведь все народы принадлежат {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.
ru.R: Встань, Боже! Суди весь мир, \q потому что все народы — {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}}.

ja.L: 立ち上がってください、神よ、地を裁いてください。 \q あなたこそ、諸国の民をことごとく受け継ぐ方だからだ。
ja.B: 神よ、立ち上がって、地を裁いてください。 \q 諸国の民はみな、あなたのものだからだ。
ja.R: 神よ、立ち上がってください！世界中を裁いてください。 \q すべての国々は、あなたのものだからだ。

uk.L: Встань, Боже, суди землю, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} заволодієш усіма народами.
uk.B: Повстань, Боже, суди землю, \q бо кожен народ належить {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}}.
uk.R: Устань, Боже! Суди весь світ, \q бо всі народи — {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}}.

decisions.choice: Arise, God
decisions.reason: As in 3:8, the call echoes Moses' words when the ark set out (Numbers 10:35). The psalmist now speaks.

decisions.choice: inherit: take as your own possession
alternatives: you rule over all the nations
decisions.reason: The verb (nachal) means to receive or hold as an inheritance. Deuteronomy 32:8-9 pictures the nations divided among heavenly beings while Israel is the LORD's own share; here God takes all the nations as his own, since the gods have failed.

decisions.choice: judge the earth: God does what the gods failed to do
decisions.reason: The psalm ends by asking God himself to bring the justice the gods would not give (96:13).

decisions.choice: tinchal "受け継ぐ方" (L), "あなたのもの" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Inherit is take as your own possession (m2, uncertain); the request qumah as the Psalter's 立ち上がってください.
